title: The bain sakina ke baba nahi aaye
body:
THE BAIN SAKINA KE HAME KOUN BACHEYE BABA NAHI AYE, RANJ-O-ALAM-O-GHAM KE HAR EK SIMT HAIN SAYE BABA NAHI AYE
QASIM HAIN NA AKBAR HAI NA ABBAS SE DILAWAR HAR SU HAI SITAMGAR, AB QAIDE MUSIBAT SE HAME KOUN CHUDAYE BABA NAHI AYE
DAM GHUT TA HAI MERA ZEHRILEE HAWA MEIN ZINDAAN-E-BALA MEIN, DUSHMAN KO BHI IS QAID SE ALLAH BACCHAYE BABA NAHI AYE
KYON MARTA HAI SHUMR-E-LAYEEN MUJHKO TAMACHE RUQSAR HAIN NEELE, KOI MERE ABBAS CHAHCHA KO TOH BULAYE BABA NAHI AYE
<<DIVIDER>>
IMDAD KARO POTI KI YA HYDER-E-KARRAR MARTI HAI DILAFGAR, KOI YE QABAR JAKE NAJAF MEIN TOH SUNADE BABA NAHI AYE
HAR WAQT WATAN JANE KI HAI MUJHKO TAMANNA PHIR DEKHU MADINA, ZINDA JO MUJHE QAID SE ALLAH CHUDAYE BABA NAHI AYE
IS TARHA KE JINE SE TOH MARJANA HAI BEHTAR HAR SAANS HAI NASHTAR, ZINDAAN MEIN KOI AKE MERI QABAR BANAYE BABA NAHI AYE..
